pacing.coverage: Six events, option screens, 900 frames each in the simulator; JNext play of all six; Downhill on hardware
pacing.result: No per-frame hook: only the menu's tape load is replaced (about 12 frames of copy); patched and original menus agree after 900 frames

dependencies.coverage: The menu's two loader callers; free runs and gameplay snapshots diffed over 0x6400-0x7500
dependencies.result: Hook uses 0x6C00-0x6C7F and 0x6D00-0x6D03, restores NextReg 0x50; events never touch that memory

feasibility.decision: Plain build with the events embedded and the menu's own loader answered from RAM; sprites later, one event at a time
